verdict.rationale: Railway's docs state outright that you can deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI, and a probe confirms an official CLI guide exists. That is a direct, first-party terminal deploy path that needs no dashboard. Missing for 10: command-level detail of the deploy workflow (e.g., specific deploy commands and flags), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard
